title: Contingent Exposure Routing for Financial AI: Outage Risk and the Cost of Indivisible Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2610.00239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model failover restores availability, but changes which financial institutions share decision errors. We formulate outage-contingent routing through a local market-impact response matrix and study expected squared price displacement. A symmetric construction shows that a shared backup can leave an order-one concentration floor as the number of primary endpoints grows, while balanced fallback risk decreases inversely with the surviving endpoint count. For indivisible decisions, we derive the exact second moment of independent randomized routing and an effective-exposure granularity that determines its gap from fractional allocation. Conditional-expectation rounding gives a finite-agent bound without coupled quotas; a separate swap procedure preserves endpoint counts and is assessed against dual lower bounds. translated_title: 面向金融人工智能的或有风险敞口路由：中断风险与不可分决策的代价
translated_abstract: 模型故障切换恢复了系统的可用性，但改变了哪些金融机构会共同承担决策错误。我们通过一个局部市场冲击响应矩阵构建了基于中断情况的或有路由机制，并研究期望平方价格位移。一个对称构造表明，随着主端点数量的增长，共享备份可能留下一个一阶量级的集中度下限，而均衡的回退风险则随存活端点数量的倒数而下降。对于不可分决策，我们推导了独立随机路由的精确二阶矩，以及一个决定其与分数分配之间差距的有效风险敞口粒度。条件期望舍入法在不使用耦合配额的情况下给出了有限代理的界；另一个独立的交换程序在保持端点数量的同时，通过双重下界进行评估。在60个合成投资组合网络和11,340次场景评估中，后者在单一与双……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出面向金融AI的中断或有风险敞口路由框架，揭示了共享备份会留下随主端点增长而无法消除的一阶集中度风险下限，并为不可分决策提供了精确二阶矩分析与保持端点数量的交换算法，在合成网络上可降低6.57%–10.53%的风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an outage-contingent exposure routing framework for financial AI, showing that a shared backup leaves an order-one concentration floor as primary endpoints grow, and provides exact second-moment analysis and a count-preserving swap procedure for indivisible decisions, reducing risk by 6.57%–10.53% on synthetic portfolio networks.
